claims.text: The FDA label says duloxetine with heavy alcohol intake may be associated with severe liver injury.
claims.quote: Use of duloxetine concomitantly with heavy alcohol intake may be associated with severe liver injury.

claims.text: The FDA label reports that duloxetine did not increase alcohol-related mental and motor impairment when peak concentrations coincided.
claims.quote: When duloxetine and ethanol were administered several hours apart so that peak concentrations of each would coincide, duloxetine did not increase the impairment of mental and motor skills caused by alcohol.

headline.text: The FDA label associates duloxetine with heavy alcohol intake with possible severe liver injury.

reported.text: In a separate label-described assessment, duloxetine did not increase alcohol-induced mental and motor impairment when peak concentrations coincided.
